store.summary: WeChat iLink chat for Cardputer Zero with pinyin input and QR friend invites
store.description: WeChat Zero brings WeChat iLink chat to the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Scan a QR code to log in, reply to incoming WeChat messages, and invite a friend by showing a second QR: once they confirm, the device can send them messages proactively. A built-in offline pinyin IME (77k entries) handles Chinese input on the 46-key keyboard, with multiple conversation channels, unread badges, remarks and persisted history.
